article_title: Poundland supplier 'will lose millions' if retailer collapses

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Poundland has opened thousands of new stores abroad.
A supplier explains how Poundland's possible collapse could harm suppliers, employees and the wider supply chain.
Highcrest has stopped selling confectionery to all retailers.
The government has already nationalised Poundland.
tasks.correct_answer: A supplier explains how Poundland's possible collapse could harm suppliers, employees and the wider supply chain.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת כיצד קריסה אפשרית של פאונדלנד עלולה לפגוע בספקים, בעובדים ובשרשרת האספקה הרחבה.

tasks.prompt: Why does Adam Turner believe Highcrest can survive losing several million pounds?
options: It is insured by the government.
It no longer depends on any retailers.
It is a longstanding business able to absorb the loss.
Gordon Brothers has promised to repay it in full.
tasks.correct_answer: It is a longstanding business able to absorb the loss.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: טרנר אמר שהייקרסט היא חברה ותיקה שיכולה לספוג את ההפסד, בניגוד לספקים קטנים יותר.

tasks.prompt: What does “stomach this” mean when Turner describes Highcrest?
options: Sell more food products
Accept or withstand a painful financial loss
Avoid paying its suppliers
Close before the Christmas period
tasks.correct_answer: Accept or withstand a painful financial loss
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאן stomach this פירושו להיות מסוגל לשאת או לספוג הפסד כספי קשה.

tasks.prompt: Why is the final three months of the year called the “golden quarter” for retailers?
options: Suppliers are paid in gold.
All debts are cancelled in October.
Stores are legally protected from insolvency.
Halloween and Christmas trading make it a crucial, high-stock sales period.
tasks.correct_answer: Halloween and Christmas trading make it a crucial, high-stock sales period.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הרבעון האחרון כולל מכירות ליל כל הקדושים ולחג המולד ולכן הוא תקופה מסחרית חשובה עם מלאי רב.

tasks.prompt: What could happen to roughly 6,000 Poundland employees if buyers take only half the stores?
options: They might not be re-employed at the sold premises.
They will automatically become secured creditors.
They will all move to Highcrest.
They will receive ownership of the remaining stores.
tasks.correct_answer: They might not be re-employed at the sold premises.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, קונים מתעניינים רק בכמחצית מהחנויות, ולכן כ־6,000 עובדים עלולים שלא לקבל עבודה חדשה באותם אתרים.

tasks.prompt: In insolvency, what does “pennies in the pound” mean?
options: Suppliers will be paid before secured creditors.
Each supplier will receive a new shop.
Creditors may recover only a small fraction of what they are owed.
Poundland will sell products for one penny.
tasks.correct_answer: Creditors may recover only a small fraction of what they are owed.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי אומר שנושים יקבלו בחזרה רק חלק קטן מאוד מן הסכום המלא המגיע להם.

tasks.prompt: Explain why small and medium-sized suppliers may be more vulnerable than Highcrest if Poundland becomes insolvent.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין לפחות שני גורמים מדויקים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Some suppliers work only for Poundland and depend heavily on it.
They may be owed the most during the high-stock golden quarter.
Suppliers are behind secured creditor Gordon Brothers in the repayment order.
Unlike Highcrest, smaller firms may not have enough financial strength to absorb a large unpaid balance.

tasks.prompt: Why does Turner describe a possible collapse as a “massive ripple effect” through the supply chain?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להראות כיצד השפעה על פאונדלנד מתפשטת לעובדים, ספקים ועסקים נוספים.
expected_points: Thousands of suppliers could lose money, and some may collapse themselves.
Warehouse, shop and head-office staff would all be affected.
The consequences could extend to tens of thousands of people beyond Poundland.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Poundland's situation, the risks to suppliers and employees, and the government's response in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מצב החברה, החוב לספקים, הסיכון לעובדים ופעולת השרים בלי לקבוע שהחברה כבר קרסה.
expected_points: Poundland is still trading and is not yet in administration, but its future is uncertain.
Highcrest expects to lose millions if it becomes insolvent, while smaller suppliers may fail.
Only about half the stores currently interest buyers, potentially leaving around 6,000 employees without re-employment.
Ministers are meeting Gordon Brothers and Poundland executives to seek clarity while avoiding interference in negotiations.
The government says it is ready to support employees if administration occurs.

tasks.prompt: Write a short briefing for a small Poundland supplier explaining the article's main financial risks.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח תדריך ענייני המבוסס רק על הכתבה ולהבחין בין סיכון לבין עובדה שכבר התרחשה.
expected_points: State that Poundland has not yet entered administration.
Explain that suppliers may recover only a fraction of unpaid invoices if insolvency occurs.
Mention that secured creditors are first in line for repayment.
Note that exposure may be highest during the high-stock final quarter.
Use cautious language and avoid claiming that collapse is certain.
